# 仅供可丢弃测试局；报告者为天朝皇帝。
# ACTOR输出新人物scope，LEVEL为原版行省契约。借用同类型原路，保存并恢复原路与治所持有人。
# 军制取样复用既有名额，避免把州制文官路改为军制时撞上全朝原生军制数量上限。
tca_test_create_local_domain_actor_effect = {
    clear_saved_scope = tca_domain_test_circuit
    clear_saved_scope = tca_domain_test_county
    random_vassal_or_below = {
        limit = { government_has_flag = government_is_celestial is_landed = yes highest_held_title_tier = tier_kingdom liege = root vassal_contract_has_flag = $LEVEL$ NOT = { has_character_flag = tca_local_domain_test_actor } }
        primary_title = { save_scope_as = tca_domain_test_circuit }
        capital_county = { save_scope_as = tca_domain_test_county }
    }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:tca_domain_test_circuit exists = scope:tca_domain_test_county }
        create_character = { age = 35 random_traits = no gender_female_chance = 0 dynasty = none employer = root culture = root.culture faith = root.faith rite = root.rite save_scope_as = $ACTOR$ }
        scope:$ACTOR$ = {
            set_variable = { name = tca_domain_test_circuit value = scope:tca_domain_test_circuit }
            set_variable = { name = tca_domain_test_county value = scope:tca_domain_test_county }
            set_variable = { name = tca_domain_test_old_circuit_holder value = scope:tca_domain_test_circuit.holder }
            set_variable = { name = tca_domain_test_old_county_holder value = scope:tca_domain_test_county.holder }
            if = {
                limit = { scope:tca_domain_test_circuit = { has_variable = tca_circuit_kind } }
                set_variable = { name = tca_domain_test_old_kind value = scope:tca_domain_test_circuit.var:tca_circuit_kind }
            }
        }
        # 原持有人可能在长时间等待、保存重载或自然年中被抽取死亡；借出期间由本夹具保护，
        # 否则清理事务会向死者交还头衔。只记录并撤销本夹具添加的保护。
        scope:tca_domain_test_circuit.holder = {
            if = { limit = { NOT = { has_character_flag = tca_local_domain_original_protected } }
                add_character_flag = tca_local_domain_original_protected
                if = { limit = { NOT = { has_trait = tca_test_death_protection } }
                    add_character_flag = tca_local_domain_original_owns_protection
                    add_trait = tca_test_death_protection
                }
            }
        }
        scope:tca_domain_test_county.holder = {
            if = { limit = { NOT = { has_character_flag = tca_local_domain_original_protected } }
                add_character_flag = tca_local_domain_original_protected
                if = { limit = { NOT = { has_trait = tca_test_death_protection } }
                    add_character_flag = tca_local_domain_original_owns_protection
                    add_trait = tca_test_death_protection
                }
            }
        }
        create_title_and_vassal_change = { type = granted add_claim_on_loss = no save_scope_as = tca_domain_test_grant }
        scope:tca_domain_test_county = { change_title_holder = { holder = scope:$ACTOR$ change = scope:tca_domain_test_grant } }
        scope:tca_domain_test_circuit = { change_title_holder = { holder = scope:$ACTOR$ change = scope:tca_domain_test_grant } }
        resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:tca_domain_test_grant
        scope:$ACTOR$ = {
            change_government = celestial_government
            create_title_and_vassal_change = { type = swear_fealty add_claim_on_loss = no save_scope_as = tca_domain_test_fealty }
            change_liege = { liege = root change = scope:tca_domain_test_fealty }
            resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:tca_domain_test_fealty
            # 真实交接若已继承同类契约，无须重设；否则只使用本次借出的同类名额。
            if = { limit = { NOT = { vassal_contract_has_flag = $LEVEL$ } } vassal_contract_set_obligation_level = { type = celestial_provinces level = $LEVEL$ } }
            add_character_modifier = { modifier = tca_test_local_domain_capacity }
            add_character_flag = tca_local_domain_test_actor
            add_character_flag = ai_will_not_convert
            tca_test_protect_character_effect = yes
            set_appointment_timeout = { years = 150 desc = appointment_timeout_desc_refusing }
            set_variable = { name = admin_contract_cooldown years = 10 }
        }
    }
}

# 每项自备政策和人物；保存旧政策供清理。无缺失scope时才进入业务断言。
tca_test_prepare_local_domain_effect = {
    save_scope_value_as = { name = tca_domain_test_old_policy value = 0 }
    if = { limit = { has_realm_law = tca_local_domain_civil_law } save_scope_value_as = { name = tca_domain_test_old_policy value = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { has_realm_law = tca_local_domain_all_law } save_scope_value_as = { name = tca_domain_test_old_policy value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_realm_law = tca_local_domain_original_law } } add_realm_law_skip_effects = tca_local_domain_original_law }
    clear_saved_scope = tca_domain_civil
    clear_saved_scope = tca_domain_military
    tca_test_create_local_domain_actor_effect = { ACTOR = tca_domain_civil LEVEL = celestial_province_standard }
    tca_test_create_local_domain_actor_effect = { ACTOR = tca_domain_military LEVEL = celestial_province_military }
    tca_sync_local_domain_realm_effect = yes
}

# 新人物作用域；只恢复本例借出的头衔，不处理任意历史人物的家门。
tca_test_restore_local_domain_actor_effect = {
    save_scope_as = tca_domain_test_restoring
    # 真实交还前先归还路类型，避免授失职回调把临时类型重新同步到原持有人契约。
    var:tca_domain_test_circuit = {
        if = {
            limit = { scope:tca_domain_test_restoring = { has_variable = tca_domain_test_old_kind } }
            set_variable = { name = tca_circuit_kind value = scope:tca_domain_test_restoring.var:tca_domain_test_old_kind }
        }
        else = { remove_variable = tca_circuit_kind }
    }
    create_title_and_vassal_change = { type = granted add_claim_on_loss = no save_scope_as = tca_domain_test_restore }
    # 先确认原持有人仍可接收；死者不能作为change_title_holder目标。
    # 存活时照常精确归还；死亡时保留明确诊断，不能静默跳过。
    if = { limit = { var:tca_domain_test_old_county_holder = { is_alive = yes } }
        var:tca_domain_test_county = { change_title_holder = { holder = scope:tca_domain_test_restoring.var:tca_domain_test_old_county_holder change = scope:tca_domain_test_restore } }
    }
    else = { debug_log = "TCA_LOCAL_DOMAIN_RESTORE_DEAD county" }
    if = { limit = { var:tca_domain_test_old_circuit_holder = { is_alive = yes } }
        var:tca_domain_test_circuit = { change_title_holder = { holder = scope:tca_domain_test_restoring.var:tca_domain_test_old_circuit_holder change = scope:tca_domain_test_restore } }
    }
    else = { debug_log = "TCA_LOCAL_DOMAIN_RESTORE_DEAD circuit" }
    resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:tca_domain_test_restore
    # 原路只从帝直属长官取样。独立场景后，退任家门可能不再直属原皇帝；
    # 仅交还头衔不会恢复领属，必须另做真实归附事务，避免后续用例失去可用路。
    if = { limit = { var:tca_domain_test_old_circuit_holder = { is_alive = yes } }
        var:tca_domain_test_old_circuit_holder = {
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { liege = root } }
                create_title_and_vassal_change = { type = swear_fealty add_claim_on_loss = no save_scope_as = tca_domain_test_restore_fealty }
                change_liege = { liege = root change = scope:tca_domain_test_restore_fealty }
                resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:tca_domain_test_restore_fealty
            }
        }
    }
    # 只撤销本夹具在原持有人身上添加的死亡保护。
    var:tca_domain_test_old_county_holder = {
        if = { limit = { has_character_flag = tca_local_domain_original_protected }
            if = { limit = { has_character_flag = tca_local_domain_original_owns_protection } remove_trait = tca_test_death_protection }
            remove_character_flag = tca_local_domain_original_owns_protection
            remove_character_flag = tca_local_domain_original_protected
        }
    }
    var:tca_domain_test_old_circuit_holder = {
        if = { limit = { has_character_flag = tca_local_domain_original_protected }
            if = { limit = { has_character_flag = tca_local_domain_original_owns_protection } remove_trait = tca_test_death_protection }
            remove_character_flag = tca_local_domain_original_owns_protection
            remove_character_flag = tca_local_domain_original_protected
        }
    }
    remove_character_modifier = tca_test_local_domain_capacity
    remove_character_flag = tca_local_domain_test_actor
    tca_test_restore_character_effect = yes
}

# 报告者作用域；恢复原政策但不重新颁布，避免测试人为增加改革费用或冷却。
tca_test_cleanup_local_domain_effect = {
    scope:tca_domain_civil ?= { tca_test_restore_local_domain_actor_effect = yes }
    scope:tca_domain_military ?= { tca_test_restore_local_domain_actor_effect = yes }
    if = { limit = { scope:tca_domain_test_old_policy = 1 } if = { limit = { NOT = { has_realm_law = tca_local_domain_civil_law } } add_realm_law_skip_effects = tca_local_domain_civil_law } }
    else_if = { limit = { scope:tca_domain_test_old_policy = 2 } if = { limit = { NOT = { has_realm_law = tca_local_domain_all_law } } add_realm_law_skip_effects = tca_local_domain_all_law } }
    else = { if = { limit = { NOT = { has_realm_law = tca_local_domain_original_law } } add_realm_law_skip_effects = tca_local_domain_original_law } }
    tca_sync_local_domain_realm_effect = yes
}
